boards.title: Every variant and tone, measured in a browser.
boards.alt: A matrix of real buttons: four variants (solid, outline, ghost, link) by seven tones. Under each button is its measured label contrast, from 4.82 to 19.89 to 1, all above the 4.5 to 1 floor. Below, all 56 labels (rest and disabled) sit on one scale to the right of the floor, and one solid brand button is shown in five states: rest 6.11, hover 9.23, focus ring 6.11, disabled 5.16, loading 6.11.

figures.label: labels measured
figures.source: measured on this board: 28 variant x tone pairs at rest + the same 28 disabled (variants and tones from src/components/Button/Button.evidence.js)

figures.label: lowest ratio
figures.source: measured on this board: disabled outline/solid/ghost neutral, 4.630 (rounded down)

boards.method: app/measure.js in the renderer: WCAG 2.x relative luminance from getComputedStyle color and the composited background of each real Button; hover and focus forced through CDP CSS.forcePseudoState; values rounded down to two decimals. Raw values: scratchpad r12-boards/out/b3-result.json. Rest values agree with the token descriptions (interactive.bg 6.11:1, solid-bg-hover 9.24:1).

boards.title: A check is trusted only after it is shown to fail.
boards.alt: Three pictures of the same card: expected, changed, and the difference. In the changed picture only the Save plan button is one step darker. In the difference picture that button is red. At Playwright's default tolerance of 0.2, 0 pixels differ; at tolerance 0, 13,442 pixels differ, so the check fails as it must.

figures.label: pixels differ at the default 0.2
figures.source: measured in this render: YIQ colour test of pixelmatch at threshold 0.2 between the two captures (840x532 device px)

figures.label: pixels differ at threshold 0
figures.source: measured in this render, same captures, threshold 0

boards.method: The change is the one in test/evidence/visual-snapshot.spec.js:349-381 (negative control: a pixel change is caught): the solid brand Button fill set to var(--ds-interactive-bg-hover). The pictures are rendered in the browser from a smaller specimen, not the repository's fixture.

boards.alt: A six-step line from edit to release: Edit (tokens/source), Build (npm run build), Static gates, Rendered evidence, Consumer smoke, and Release, each with its real step names.
